title: Installation Jobs: Volume Pricing for Exterior Trim Capping
content:
**Volume pricing for exterior trim capping — Installation Jobs**

How the capping price on an **Installation Jobs** record is built depends on the priced openings of the job. The priced openings belong to the contract the job installs — the **Window Replacement Contracts** contract of a window job, or the **Entry & Patio Door Contracts** contract of a door job — and capping is priced on every opening on that contract.

## Price ladder

| Priced openings | Capping price |
|---|---|
| 12 or more | the first 10 at the method's exterior capping charge per opening, and every priced opening beyond 10 at 75 percent of it |
| 6 or more but fewer than 12 | every priced opening at 90 percent of the method's exterior capping charge per opening |
| fewer than 6 | every priced opening at the method's exterior capping charge per opening |

## Worked examples (hypothetical charge of 89.00 per opening)

| Priced openings | Working | Capping price |
|---|---|---|
| 14 | 10 at 89.00 is 890.00; 4 at 75 percent of 89.00 is 267.00; together | 1,157.00 |
| 12 | 10 at 89.00 is 890.00; 2 at 66.75 is 133.50; together | 1,023.50 |
| 11 | 11 at 90 percent of 89.00, that is 11 at 80.10 | 881.10 |
| 6 | 6 at 90 percent of 89.00 | 480.60 |
| 5 | 5 at 89.00 | 445.00 |

The band is fixed by the priced openings of the job as a whole; within the first band, the openings beyond 10 are the ones priced at 75 percent.
